game.desc: AC/DC Live: Rock Band Track Pack is nothing less than the essential song pack for every rock fan on Xbox 360. You will find 18 classic songs from this mythical band live. Amongst others, the famous Highway to Hell, For Those About too Rock, Hells Bells and Thunderstruck.
